subject: Discovery recap: Redwood + Orion Data
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orion-data.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@orion-data.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: Redwood + Orion Data

Hi Samantha & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about Orion Data's ingestion pipeline and the latency/cost constraints you outlined. Per our call, here's a short recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (high level):
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and P99 latency for customer-facing summarization (current infra: mixed CPU/GPU batch jobs).
- Key constraints: HIPAA-like data governance for PHI, strict retention windows, and existing S3-based artifact store.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in per-request token cost while maintaining >=95% percentile latency target (~400ms).

What we discussed as a pilot:
1) Small pilot using our hosted API with a private VPC peering test for 2 model endpoints (summarization, intent classification). Duration: 4 weeks.
2) Provide an evaluation harness + cost/latency report; Redwood handles model selection/quantization recommendations.
3) Security: run through your SOC2 checklist and provide audit logs/access controls.

Next steps / suggested owners:
- Marissa (me): send pilot SOW + sample config and the product deck (attached) — due: EOD Mon 2/8.
- Samantha / Tom: confirm pilot scope (endpoints, sample traffic profile) and list any additional compliance docs you need.

If that all sounds right I can put together a short mutual action plan and a 15—30m kickoff the week of 2/15.

Attached: Redwood-ProdDeck-V2.pdf
Recap link: https://redwood.app/s/orion-recap-123

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orion-data.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Bump: Discovery recap — quick check-in

Hi Samantha —

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Wanted to check whether the pilot we discussed is still a priority for you and Tom for Q1 / early Q2. Quick options:

- If it is a priority: can we schedule a 15-min call this week to lock scope? I have openings Tue 2/16 10:00am or Wed 2/17 2:00pm PT.
- If timing changed: let me know the new timeframe and I'll adjust the mutual action plan accordingly.
- If it's not a fit: totally fine — just tell me and I'll close the loop.

Quick reminder of what I shared: a 4-week pilot using Redwood's hosted endpoints (private VPC option) to validate latency/cost with concrete optimization recommendations. I attached the deck in my previous note and included a short replay link: https://redwood.app/s/orion-recap-123

Appreciate any quick signal — even just a one-line note.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orion-data.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bump: Discovery recap — quick check-in

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and the clear recap. Apologies for the delay — we had some shifting priorities here. After discussing internally, we need to deprioritize new inference pilots until our Q3 infra funding cycle. That means we won't be able to move forward with a pilot in the immediate timeframe.

Appreciate the materials — please keep me updated on new benchmarks or case studies relevant to streaming summarization; happy to revisit once our budget window opens.

Best,
Samantha
